# About Me

Hi! I’m Mackenzie Lindholm, a senior at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) pursuing a double degree in Statistics & Data Science and Cognitive Science. I’m especially interested in applying data-driven approaches to better understand human behavior and complex real-world systems.

I enjoy combining a strong technical background with communication and client-facing work, translating data insights into clear, actionable decisions for diverse audiences.

I’m currently seeking full-time opportunities starting in 2026 in data science, data engineering, product management, or related roles where I can leverage both analytical and communication skills to drive impact.
